attributes.action: Review the decision to use former RAF Barnham site for asylum accommodation
attributes.additional_details: We call on the Government to reconsider its decision to use the former RAF Barnham site for large-scale asylum accommodation. The proposal could place additional pressure on local GP surgeries, NHS services, roads, policing and community facilities. Residents have not been properly consulted on a change of this scale. Concerns also remain regarding community impact, safeguarding and the site’s proximity to UK and US military facilities. Alternative locations should be considered.
attributes.background: Reconsider the use of RAF Barnham for large-scale asylum accommodation until a full independent assessment of impacts on local services, infrastructure, community safety and nearby military facilities has been completed.

rejection.details: This concerns a local matter. A more generalised petition on the merits of the use of RAF bases nationally to house asylum seekers would be an acceptable subject for an e-petition.
